_read_me: How the bot talks to Matthew's Moomoo Canada account. Read by stock_bot.py --moomoo on his Mac (never on GitHub). Setup steps: stock_bot/MOOMOO-SETUP.md.
_env: simulate = Moomoo's own paper account (fake money, real order system). real = his real account. Even with real, nothing is bought unless live_auto_trade is true AND he has clicked Unlock in OpenD that day.
_bankroll_usd: The most the bot may ever have in play, in US dollars, whatever else sits in the account. Moomoo's paper account starts with far more; this keeps its bets the same size as the practice account's. Raise it by hand when deposits should count.
